decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a three storey     
side extension  to incorporate a lift shaft and lift at the nursing home, 
because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable 
having due regard for the site characteristics of  Dudley House 
Nursing Home and is complementary to the visual amenity of the 
locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and 
neighbouring properties or the Spring Grove Conservation Area.  The 
development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New 
Development),  ENVB 1.2 - (High buildings or structures affecting sensitive areas),  ENVB 1.8 - (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), ENVB 2.2 - (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 - (Extensions and Alterations), 	 C 3.2 - (New or extended health facilities) of the London  Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant  with Council's "Think Access" Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the liftshaft is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeast wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a 3 storey lift tower to  south east side of existing building. (Amended Plans)
